title: Bride & Groom Wedding Day, 1950s Vintage B&W Photo
description: A black and white mid-20th-century snapshot capturing a newly married bride and groom standing together outside following their ceremony. The bride wears a mid-century style long-sleeved white gown with a lace trim veil and carries a flower bouquet. The groom is dressed in a white dinner jacket tuxedo with a black bow tie. They pose in front of a light-colored cinderblock building wall flanked by garden shrubbery.
